caption: The video captures a winter woodland beneath an overcast gray sky, where snow blankets the ground and clings to a large mound of cut, leafless branches on the right. A fire burns actively inside this brush mound, sending up a tall column of orange-yellow flame that flickers continuously, its height and shape shifting as the fire burns. Faint smoke drifts weakly above the flames without altering the surrounding layout. Bare birch trunks and tall leafless trees fill the left and background, showing no obvious sway or collapse. As the view shifts right and pulls back, the burning pile recedes within the frame, while more of the snowy clearing and a stack of logs at the far right edge come into view. The flame and smoke remain the clearest motion against the largely still trees and ground.
